elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Contractor must, at Company’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “at Contractor’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “return to Company all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Company,” which substantively covers Customer Data.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” satisfying the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, Contractor must “delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after the data is returned and deleted.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “certify such deletion to Company in writing” after return.

elements.element: The transition-assistance and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Contractor must, at Company’s request, provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Contractor must return to Company all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is expressly required within thirty days after the relevant expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative added paragraph—not merely the margin comment—covers every preferred requirement, and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It is confined to transition assistance, data return, deletion, and certification without changing the existing termination, payment, or work-product provisions. Drafting is strong, although the data obligation could be scoped more carefully when only one Statement of Work terminates, so that deletion of all Company data does not inadvertently affect another continuing Statement of Work.
